summary:
Iter21 SAWALI — per-client SMART Communications feature flags + AI summary→Report conversion + SMS/OVH/PawaPay admin settings + WhatsApp content-focused AI prompt + notes privacy. BACKEND: 9/9 passed in /app/backend/tests/test_sawali_iter21.py (~3.3s). Coverage by class: (A) TestFeatures — GET /api/me/features (admin) returns features={whatsapp,sms,ai,payments}=all True with inherited_from=null; GET /api/admin/clients/{fresh_id}/features returns DEFAULT_CLIENT_FEATURES (all False) with client.id/full_name/company; PUT with {whatsapp:true,ai:true} merges then GET back confirms persistence; second PUT with {sms:true} preserves whatsapp+ai (exclude_none partial-update verified); 404 returned for unknown client_id with French detail. (B) TestNotesPrivacy — POST /api/me/notes/reports with is_private=true persists the flag; GET /me/notes/reports returns it; PUT with is_private=false flips it; persistence verified by re-GET. (C) TestSummaryToReport — POST /api/me/ai/summaries/{nope}/to-report returns 404 'Synthèse introuvable'. With a seeded ai_summaries doc (admin user_id, multi-line summary, provider=openai, model=gpt-4o-mini), POST returns ok=true, kind='reports', report.is_private=true, content_html STARTS with

(newlines→paragraphs), contains 'Généré automatiquement' attribution footer with provider='openai'; source_summary_id back-link present. (D) TestAiSummarySystemPrompt — verified the new ChatGPT prompt by routing the call through n8n→httpbin.org/anything echo: response surfaces the system_prompt field which contains 'Analyse précisément le CONTENU des messages WhatsApp' (unicode-escaped in JSON echo, accent-tolerant assertion) AND the 5 bullet markers (1)..(5). (E) TestAdminSettingsSmsOvhPawapay — PUT /api/admin/settings with 38 new SMS-Orange/Moov/Telecel/OVH/PawaPay fields persists; GET masks all 12 secrets (sms_*_token, sms_*_basic_pass, sms_*_header_value, sms_ovh_application_secret, sms_ovh_consumer_key, pawapay_api_token) as '********' while plain fields (enabled/url/method/auth_type/sender/endpoint/application_key/service_name/environment/country/basic_user/header_name) round-trip exactly; raw db.settings still holds the unmasked values; sending '********' for pawapay_api_token does NOT overwrite the real value (mask placeholder detection). All teardowns reset state. FRONTEND PLAYWRIGHT: Login (admin@sawalismartsystems.com + dev OTP) succeeded → admin/portal flows tested. ✓ /admin/clients renders 3 [data-testid='features-client-{id}'] shield links. ✓ Click navigates to /admin/clients/{id}/features which exposes [data-testid='admin-client-features-page'] + the 4 toggles features-toggle-whatsapp/-sms/-ai/-payments. ✓ [data-testid='features-save-btn'] is disabled at load (clean state) and becomes enabled after toggling whatsapp (dirty tracking works). ✓ /admin/settings exposes sms-orange-block, sms-moov-block, sms-telecel-block, sms-ovh-enabled, pawapay-enabled, pawapay-api-token, pawapay-environment, pawapay-country (8/8 testids found). ✓ /portal/notes/reports → open create form → [data-testid='note-privacy-toggle'] is rendered AND the body text mentions 'micro' (audio-transcription help banner present). ✗ Dashboard AI testid NOT visible at /portal/dashboard — route returned the public marketing homepage; likely the dashboard lives at a different URL (e.g. /portal or /dashboard) — visual screenshot showed admin landing on public homepage with 'Mon espace' shown in nav (auth confirmed). Iter20 source-grep already verified Dashboard.jsx L71 [data-testid='dashboard-ai-summary-btn'] exists, so this is a routing/nav issue rather than a missing component. Recommend main agent confirm the actual portal dashboard route name and rerun this single check.

integration_issues.issue: GET /portal/dashboard rendered the public marketing homepage during automation — could not visually verify [data-testid='dashboard-ai-summary-btn'] (testid confirmed in source by iter20). Likely a route-name mismatch in this iteration's test script; needs main agent confirmation of the canonical portal dashboard URL.

action_items: (MEDIUM) Confirm canonical portal dashboard route name (the test hit /portal/dashboard and was redirected to the public homepage). Once known, main agent can self-test the AI button disabled state when /me/features.ai=false and the 'Rapport' button [data-testid='ai-summary-history-to-report-{id}'] in the 'Mes synthèses' tab.

(LOW, carry-over) server.py is now ~8585 lines. Per-client features + summary-to-report + 28 SMS settings fields added another ~250 lines. Suggest splitting into routers: ai.py (summarize+history+to-report), sms.py (3 BF operators + OVH + PawaPay), features.py (admin/me/clients flags).
(LOW) Hydration warning observed in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' and 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' (Geographies render). Cosmetic — not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py DEFAULT_CLIENT_FEATURES + _normalize_features (~L1211-1224): defaults all-False is the safe choice (paid services off until explicitly enabled). bool() coercion + dict(default).update() pattern guards against partial/legacy docs. ✓

server.py admin_update_client_features (~L1245-1257): payload.model_dump(exclude_none=True) with current.update() performs a clean partial merge; features_updated_at audit field stamped. Verified end-to-end by iter21 test. ✓

server.py me_get_features (~L1260-1277): role-aware resolution — admin/superviseur=all True (no inheritance), tracked user resolves parent via client_id, plain client reads own doc. Returns 'inherited_from' (id+full_name+company) only when actually inherited — clean for the UI tooltip. ✓

server.py _check_feature stub (~L1280): stays a no-op pending real enforcement. Acceptable as documented in spec; recommend wiring it into /me/whatsapp/send and /me/sms/send before going live so the flag actually gates billing.

server.py me_summary_to_report (~L2879-2932): clean kind switch (suivis vs reports) with prefix RPT/SUI; ownership check (admin OR own summary); HTML-escapes < and > in summary body before paragraph wrap (good — prevents stored-XSS via summary text); attribution footer hard-coded to slate-500 11px (consistent with existing CMS). source_summary_id back-link enables future re-render/regeneration. ✓

server.py me_list_notes (~L3273-3313): privacy scoping is correct — admin/superviseur unrestricted, elevated creator sees non-private+own, plain user sees own only. The $or merge into $and when q is provided properly preserves both filters. ✓

server.py me_ai_summarize sys_prompt (~L2729-2737): single string with explicit '(1)..(5)' bullet markers makes the assertion checkable from the n8n echo path. The 'Analyse précisément le CONTENU des messages WhatsApp (et non pas seulement les métadonnées)' phrasing matches the user's request verbatim. ✓

server.py admin_get_settings + admin_update_settings (~L4610-4647): SECRET_FIELDS extended consistently (12 new entries). Mask placeholder '********' detection prevents accidental overwrite — round-trip safe. ✓
models.py SettingsUpdate adds 30+ Optional[str/bool] fields for SMS/OVH/PawaPay — all properly typed. UserNoteCreate/Update gains is_private: Optional[bool]. ✓
AdminClientFeatures.jsx — verified live: 4 toggle cards, save-btn disabled until dirty, then enabled. data-testid='admin-client-features-page' on the wrapper. ✓
AdminClients.jsx — shield links rendered as [data-testid='features-client-{id}'] (3 found). ✓
AdminSettings.jsx — sms-orange-block / sms-moov-block / sms-telecel-block / sms-ovh-enabled / pawapay-enabled / pawapay-api-token / pawapay-environment / pawapay-country all present. ✓
UserNotes.jsx — note-privacy-toggle + mic transcription banner copy both detected. ✓

seed_data_creation: Module-scoped fresh_client fixture creates a TEST client (test-iter21-XXXXXX@example.com) and deletes it on teardown via _sync_db.users.delete_one. TestSummaryToReport inserts a TEST_sum_* doc into ai_summaries, deletes it + the converted report on teardown. TestAiSummarySystemPrompt + TestAdminSettingsSmsOvhPawapay snapshot prev settings doc and restore via $unset+$set on teardown. No data persisted across runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter21 suite = /app/backend/tests/test_sawali_iter21.py (5 classes / 9 tests, ~3.3s). Two upstream dependencies: the n8n-prompt test hits httpbin.org/anything — it skips with pytest.skip if httpbin is unreachable (502/504). The /admin/clients fixture creates a real test user with email pattern test-iter21-*@example.com — must be a valid Pydantic-recognized email domain (the @sawali-test.local domain failed initially because email-validator flags .local as a special-use TLD; switched to @example.com). For the dashboard route, confirm with the main agent the canonical portal URL — it's not /portal/dashboard. Pytest invocation: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_sawali_iter21.py -v --tb=short --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_iter21.xml`.
rca of the issue: Two minor test-time issues encountered and fixed during the run: (1) initial fresh_client fixture used @sawali-test.local — Pydantic's email-validator rejects .local (RFC 6762 special-use TLD) → switched to @example.com (IANA reserved-for-tests). (2) initial system_prompt assertion looked for the literal accented string 'analyse précisément' in the n8n echo, but httpbin returns the JSON body twice — once as a string with \u00e9 escapes (under 'data') and once as a parsed nested object — both serializations made the accented match unreliable. Loosened to 'Analyse pr' + 'CONTENU des messages WhatsApp' (the latter is ASCII-safe and uniquely identifies the new prompt). Also asserts the (1)..(5) bullet markers, which are accent-free.
